author: claude
summary: Task 006 of the voices-variants-round2 plan: converts class/gender/age attribute editing in the Voice Lab Overview tab from OneSelect chip-rows to SearchableSelect single-select comboboxes (these three are one-required per voice-taxonomy.json). accent/pace stay on OneSelect, unchanged.

files.change: Split the old oneFields=['class','gender','age','accent','pace'] into comboboxFields=['class','gender','age'] (new SearchableSelect render block, options from the same getSection(key) taxonomy source, showCreateNew=false) and oneFields=['accent','pace'] (unchanged OneSelect render path). SearchableSelect's built-in 'None' option can't actually be hidden (unconditionally rendered regardless of noneLabel) -- onChange wraps the sentinel value 'none' back to undefined so the existing requiredMissing save-blocking check still works correctly.

Added tests for combobox rendering of class/gender/age, absence of a Create-New action, and required-field save-blocking with the new control. Fixed a pre-existing fixture/taxonomy mismatch (gender: 'female' -> 'feminine', the real taxonomy id) that only became test-visible once the resolved label renders in the trigger button.

flow_impact: Third task landed in the voices-variants-round2 plan. Unblocks task 007 (disclosure panel), which also touches OverviewTab.tsx and was sequenced to land after this one to avoid a same-file collision.
